Routines & bundles

How it all fits together

Layer skincare from the thinnest texture to the thickest and finish every morning with sunscreen. Or skip the guesswork and buy a routine as a bundle.

Morning routine

  1. Cleanse with CeraVe Foaming Facial Cleanser to remove overnight oil.
  2. Tone with Glow Recipe Watermelon Glow Toner to prep and hydrate.
  3. Treat with La Roche-Posay Pure Vitamin C10 for an antioxidant glow.
  4. Moisturize with Neutrogena Hydro Boost Water Gel light enough for under makeup.
  5. Protect with a broad-spectrum sunscreen, SPF 30 or higher, every day.

Evening routine

  1. Cleanse with CeraVe Foaming Facial Cleanser to lift makeup and sunscreen.
  2. Treat with The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% for pores and oil.
  3. Smooth with Sweet Chef Beet + Vitamin A two to three nights a week.
  4. Spot care with La Roche-Posay Effaclar Duo(+) on blemish-prone areas.
  5. Moisturize with CeraVe Daily Moisturizing Lotion to seal it all in.

Everyday face

  1. Prime with e.l.f. Power Grip Primer so makeup grips.
  2. Conceal with Maybelline Instant Anti-Age Eraser under the eyes.
  3. Flush with Rare Beauty Soft Pinch Liquid Blush one dot per cheek.
  4. Define with Maybelline Sky High Mascara from root to tip.
  5. Set with NYX The Marshmellow Setting Spray in an X and a T.

Routine bundles

Each bundle combines products that work well together, for less than buying them one by one.

Frequently asked questions

How long does delivery take?

1–3 business days within Riyadh and 2–5 business days across the rest of Saudi Arabia. Orders of SAR 200 or more ship free.

Which payment methods can I use?

Cash on delivery, or card on the courier’s terminal when your order arrives. Card details are never requested online.

Can I return a product?

Unopened products in their original packaging can be returned within 14 days. For hygiene reasons, opened products are only returnable if faulty.

Is Aya Beauty a real store?

No. Aya Beauty is a demo store designed for a university project, so nothing is sold. Product names, photos and trademarks belong to their brands.

One email every two weeks with seasonal routines, new arrivals and early access to offers.
